answer_2.quote: We evaluate responses with StrongREJECT, an evaluation framework for malicious requests that more reliably captures these cases... We also report Attack Success Rate (ASR) and Average Harmfulness Score (AHS) as evaluation metrics.

answer_3.quote: Due to computational constraints, evaluations were conducted using GPT-4o-mini-2024-07-18... we use GPT-4o-mini acting as an LLM-as-a-judge, a commonly used approach in the jailbreak community.
